headline.en: UNI stuck below its own $5.96 DAO fair-value anchor; net inflation still outweighs the burn, but v4 fee expansion is the live catalyst.
headline.zh: UNI 仍压在 DAO 自设的 $5.96 公允价值锚之下；净通胀仍大于销毁量, 但 v4 费用开关扩容是当前最实在的催化剂.

keyChanges.en: Annualized revenue $83.79M → 17% buyback burns only 3.08M UNI/yr against 20M emission, leaving net supply +1.91%/yr inflationary.
keyChanges.zh: 年化协议收入 $83.79M, 17% 回购仅销毁 3.08M UNI, 对冲不了 20M 的固定增发, 净供应仍 +1.91%/年通胀.

keyChanges.en: TVL +8.43% over 7d to $3.25B and two v4 fee-expansion temp checks (5 more chains + fee system upgrade) are live in the forum.
keyChanges.zh: TVL 7 日 +8.43% 至 $3.25B, 论坛同时挂着两个 v4 费用开关扩容的 temp check(新增五条链 + 费率系统升级).

keyChanges.en: Spot at $4.63 sits 22% below the $5.96 treasury-burn anchor and inside the $4–7 institutional accumulation zone; funding flat +0.01%, OI thin at $31M.
keyChanges.zh: 现货 $4.63 低于 $5.96 国库销毁锚 22%, 处于 $4–7 机构吸筹区; funding 持平 +0.01%, 未平仓合约仅 $31M, 盘面轻.

contrarianObservation.en: If both v4 temp checks reach on-chain vote and pass, revenue base could step up 30–50% mechanically; at $4.63 that flips net-emission math toward neutral/deflationary before any real-yield RFC is even tabled. The setup is asymmetric long, not range-bound.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若两个 v4 temp check 都推进到正式投票并通过, 收入基数可机械性抬升 30–50%; 在 $4.63 的价位上, 这足以把净增发算式推向中性甚至通缩, 且根本不需要 real yield 提案先过关. 这其实是不对称做多结构, 而非震荡.

watchNext.en: Whether the two v4 fee-expansion temp checks escalate from forum to Snapshot/on-chain vote within 2–3 weeks.
watchNext.zh: 两个 v4 费用开关 temp check 能否在 2–3 周内从论坛推进到 Snapshot 或链上投票.

watchNext.en: Any RFC movement on redirecting buybacks from burn to stakers — the real regime-change trigger.
watchNext.zh: 回购从销毁改为分配给质押者的 RFC 是否有新动向, 这才是真正的范式切换触发点.

watchNext.en: BTC dominance at 57.93%; a roll-over would unlock alt beta, a continuation keeps UNI bid-less.
watchNext.zh: BTC.D 已 57.93%, 若见顶回落可释放山寨 beta, 若继续走高 UNI 将继续无买盘.

fullReasoning.en: Headline price action (-0.86% 24h, +3.46% 7d) is noise; the real tape is the supply math. At $4.63, 17% of $83.79M annualized revenue retires ~3.08M UNI against 20M emission — UNI is still net +1.91% inflationary despite the burn narrative. That is why spot cannot hold above the $5.96 DAO anchor: the market is pricing exactly this gap. On the other hand, TVL is up 8.43% in a week, protocol revenue is real, and two concrete temp checks (v4 on five more chains + fee system upgrade) target the one lever that actually matters — expanding the revenue base so burn > emission at today's price. Derivatives tell you no one is positioned: funding ~0, OI only $31M on a $2.8B mcap, L/S 1.61 is mild retail long bias, not fuel. BTC dominance at 57.93% keeps alt beta suppressed. The SEC decentralization thread is a tail risk worth noting but not pricing. Net: range-bound $4–5 until one of three things prints — v4 fee expansion vote, a real-yield RFC, or a BTC.D roll. Opportunistic bid belongs in the $4.00–4.20 zone with a stop under $3.80; chasing above $5 before governance delivers is paying for hope.
fullReasoning.zh: 表面价格(-0.86% 24h, +3.46% 7d)是噪音, 真正的盘面是供应算式. $4.63 价位上, 年化收入 $83.79M 的 17% 回购只能销毁约 3.08M UNI, 对冲不了 20M 增发, 即便有销毁叙事, UNI 仍是 +1.91% 的净通胀资产. 这正是现货无法站稳 $5.96 DAO 国库锚之上的原因, 市场精确定价了这个缺口. 另一面, TVL 7 日 +8.43%, 协议收入是真金白银, 论坛上两个 temp check(v4 新增五条链, 以及费率系统升级)瞄准的正是唯一真正重要的杠杆, 即扩大收入基数, 让销毁在当前价位超过增发. 衍生品告诉你没人上杠杆: funding 约 0, $2.8B 市值下 OI 仅 $31M, 多空账户比 1.61 只是轻微散户偏多, 不构成燃料. BTC.D 57.93% 压制山寨 beta. SEC 去中心化讨论是需要记在本上的尾部风险, 但不进定价. 综合判断: $4–5 区间震荡, 直到以下三件事之一落地: v4 费用开关扩容投票, real yield RFC, 或 BTC.D 见顶. 机会性买入放在 $4.00–4.20 并在 $3.80 下设止损; 在治理落地之前追到 $5 以上就是在为预期付费.
